When armed with a lightsaber, his opponent's only option is usually that of escape. |game_text=Deploy on Maul. While on Maul, may not be stolen. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value. |printings='''Decipher''' — '''this page''' (11_99) |sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists index] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008) * [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Weapon: Maul's Lightsaber, Tatooine, R |strategy=By Martin Arlthttps://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/maulslightsaber.html What? No cool double-bladed lightsaber? Relax. This is the [[Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere){{!}}Tatooine]] expansion, remember? [[Maul]] just used a single-bladed version in this part of the movie. As such, this weapon follows the format established by other unique lightsaber cards, with one notable exception. When [[Maul]] is using this weapon, it cannot be stolen. This simple bit of gametext protects [[Maul's Lightsaber]] from annoying interrupts like [[Weapon Levitation]], that can result in the Dark Side suddenly finding itself weaponless in a battle. In addition, [[Maul]] can make excellent use of his weapon. [[Maul]] can effectively ignore the presence of Light Side characters of ability less than 4. This means he can Force drain while at their site, using [[Maul's Lightsaber]] to add 1 to the Force drain. He can also use cards like [[Sniper]] to take pot-shots at those poor, low-ability characters, gradually reducing their numbers at his site. Light Side alien swarm decks will want to avoid this armed Dark Jedi as much as possible. Finally, like other lightsabers, [[Maul's Lightsaber]] gets two weapons destiny draws, making it easier to hit even high-ability characters like [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]] and Qui-Gon. [[Maul]] also has the advantage of using [[Maul's Electrobinoculars]] to rig a high destiny draw, practically guaranteeing a hit against even a Jedi Master if you take the time! |pulled_by=* [[I Will Finish What You Started]][https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Maul%27s%20Lightsaber Scomp: Maul's Lightsaber]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec).
